_comment: Install once, globally, in ~/.claude/settings.json. Merge the 'hooks' block
below into yours and correct the path to where you cloned Agent-Kit.
The hook is inert everywhere by default. It exits immediately unless it
finds .ste-writing.json at the root of the repository it is running in, so
installing it globally does not switch it on for anything. Run the
ste-writing skill inside a repository to opt that repository in.
To opt a repository back out, delete its .ste-writing.json.
The command uses $HOME rather than ~, because ~ only expands when the
command goes through a shell. An absolute path works too.
The hook passes no --mode. The linter reads the mode for each file from the
marker, so a path listed in 'strict_paths' is gated at ste-strict even in a
Stop hooks do not take matchers. They fire on every turn that ends.
